53% of Temple listings cut their price — but most buyers read that stat wrong.

It doesn't mean the market is broken. It means a chunk of sellers priced ambitiously, sat 30 days, and corrected toward what the market would actually pay. That's a working market doing what it does.

The homes that close within 4% of the original list price aren't negotiating much. The homes that took a 10% price reduction are a different category — those are the real negotiation opportunities right now.

Most buyers lump both into one bucket and either overpay on the firm ones or miss the soft ones.
